title: Meta Acquires Robotics AI Company To Fast-track Humanoid Robot Development: Report
key_facts: Meta has completed the acquisition of Assured Robot Intelligence (ARI), a startup building AI models for robots, according to Bloomberg; a Meta spokesperson confirmed the deal to Bloomberg.
The deal is part of Meta's push to build humanoid robot technology.

ARI's team, including co-founders Lerrel Pinto and Xiaolong Wang, joins the research division of Meta Superintelligence Labs and will work with Meta Robotics Studio, a team set up last year for humanoid technology.
Wang was previously a researcher at Nvidia; Pinto co-founded Fauna Robotics, which Amazon bought in March 2026 for its own humanoid effort.
Meta described ARI as working on robots that 'understand, predict and adapt to human behaviors in complex and dynamic environments'.
quote_evidence: A spokesperson for Meta confirmed the acquisition, which is a part of a major initiative to build humanoid technology, according to a Bloomberg report.
According to Bloomberg, the Assured Robot Intelligence team, including co-founders Lerrel Pinto and Xiaolong Wang, will join Meta Superintelligence Labs' research division.
why_it_matters_hint: Meta joins Amazon in buying up the small teams that teach robots to act around people, so the humanoid race is now a talent race among the giants.
notes: Stocktwits is a relay of Bloomberg's reporting; the Bloomberg original URL was not found via Google News and bloomberg.com is blocked here, so the link is the Stocktwits page. Confirmed by a Meta spokesperson to Bloomberg. Price not disclosed.
